items.headline: Real Madrid batter PSV 5-1 — and City and Arsenal both stumble at home
items.body: Champions League Matchday 5 served up a wild Tuesday night. Kylian Mbappé and Jude Bellingham led Real Madrid to a 5-1 demolition of PSV, while two of the favorites slipped up on their own turf: Manchester City were pegged back to a 2-2 draw by Napoli, and Arsenal were held 1-1 by Borussia Dortmund. Galatasaray also knocked off Aston Villa 1-0.
items.say: Did you catch the Champions League last night? Real Madrid put five past PSV, and somehow both Man City and Arsenal got held to draws at home. Those midweek European nights are the best. You follow it at all?

links.text: Real Madrid rout PSV; City & Arsenal draw (Yahoo Sports)

items.headline: Football the night before Thanksgiving? The Packers and Rams make history tonight
items.body: The NFL is trying something brand-new: its first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game, Packers at Rams tonight at SoFi Stadium (8 p.m. ET), streaming only on Netflix. It's a juicy NFC matchup — and a nice warm-up before Thursday's three-game Thanksgiving feast.
items.say: The NFL's got a game tonight — the first Thanksgiving Eve game they've ever done. Packers at the Rams, on Netflix. Football the night before Thanksgiving too? I'm not mad about it. You watching?

links.text: How to watch the Thanksgiving Eve game (CBS Sports)

items.headline: Tatum torches the Wizards — 41 points as the Celtics roll
items.body: On a quieter Tuesday slate, Jayson Tatum poured in a game-high 41 to lead Boston past Washington 131-116, with Paul George chipping in 28. Anthony Davis kept the Wizards within range with 33 of his own, but the Celtics were just too much.
items.say: Jayson Tatum went for 41 last night as the Celtics rolled — the guy's such a smooth scorer. You catching any NBA this season?

items.headline: Rivalry Week is here — and 'The Game' headlines Saturday
items.body: The best weekend on the college football calendar has arrived: Rivalry Week, when everyone settles old scores. The marquee clash is Ohio State vs. Michigan — 'The Game' — on Saturday, with bragging rights and playoff stakes scattered all across the slate.
items.say: It's Rivalry Week in college football — Ohio State and Michigan on Saturday is the big one. Even if you don't follow it all year, that game's always a scene. You have a team?

items.headline: Boom! Nicolas Cage becomes John Madden in 'Madden'
items.body: Perfect timing for football week: 'Madden,' the biopic of the legendary coach-turned-broadcaster-turned-video-game-icon, is streaming now on Prime Video. Nicolas Cage disappears into the role under heavy prosthetics, with Christian Bale as Raiders owner Al Davis.
items.say: There's a John Madden movie out now with Nicolas Cage playing him — full prosthetics, the whole deal. Feels like the right week for it. You grow up with the Madden video games?

items.headline: A cozy, chaotic Christmas rom-com just landed — 'Clashing Through the Snow'
items.body: If you need something low-stakes and festive, Prime Video's new holiday rom-com 'Clashing Through the Snow' is streaming now. Christopher Briney and Michelle Randolph play rival book editors stuck sharing a road trip to New York — with a scene-stealing supporting cast that somehow includes Paris Hilton and Julia Fox.
items.say: There's a new cheesy Christmas rom-com on Prime — rival editors on a road trip, and somehow Paris Hilton and Julia Fox are in it. Perfect background movie while you cook. You a Hallmark-Christmas-movie person?

links.text: Clashing Through The Snow — Official Trailer (Prime Video)

items.headline: U2 and Dolly Parton?! Tonight's halftime show is going to be something
items.body: Here's a duet nobody saw coming: U2 just teamed with Dolly Parton on a new song, 'Torn' — and the band headlines the halftime show at tonight's Packers-Rams game on Netflix, marking 50 years since they formed in Dublin. Big, goosebumps, singalong energy.
items.say: Did you know U2 and Dolly Parton made a song together? It's really good — and U2's playing the halftime of that Netflix game tonight for their 50th anniversary. You a U2 person?

links.text: U2 to headline the Thanksgiving Eve halftime show (Netflix Tudum)

items.headline: An almost-unbelievable true WWII football story — 'The Mosquito Bowl' hits Netflix
items.body: Peter Berg's 'The Mosquito Bowl' lands on Netflix today. It tells the real story of a group of college football stars who traded the gridiron for the Marines after Pearl Harbor and played one legendary pickup game on a Pacific island before shipping into battle. A gut-punch of a story with a loaded young cast.
items.say: There's a new Netflix movie, 'The Mosquito Bowl' — true story about college football players who became Marines in WWII. Sounds intense but amazing. You into those based-on-a-true-story war movies?
